threshold_rationale: Pei confirmed team agreement in this chat on 24 October 2026, before final held-out evaluation. Use the existing joint mean-CV-AP selection policy: candidates within one standard error of the highest mean AP qualify; prefer original, then class_weight, then smote, then higher mean AP. The operational objective is at least 80% recall on development OOF predictions. Among thresholds meeting this objective, choose the highest precision. This prioritises identifying potentially fraudulent providers while accepting the observed validation review workload of 701/4328 providers. This is a project assumption, not an empirically established business cost optimum or a guarantee of 80% recall on unseen data.
